title: lichen-core: add next_header::IPV6_IN_IPV6 (41) + gateway inner Hop Limit decrement on encapsulation
description: Smallest child of b7z9.4 (root-side encapsulation conformance, spec 05-routing 8.9 R-05-066). (a) rust/lichen-core/src/ipv6.rs next_header module (lines 20-36): add pub const IPV6_IN_IPV6: u8 = 41; (b) rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs mesh_to_mesh encapsulation branch (~1660-1685): currently outer[7]=64 and inner ipv6 untouched - per spec the root MUST decrement the inner Hop Limit by the initial Segments Left (num_addrs); when the root is forwarding rather than originating the inner packet it MUST first apply the normal forwarding decrement (inner is forwarded here: mesh_to_mesh is only called from upstream_to_mesh TUN path, gateway.rs:1557); guard: initial Segments Left MUST be strictly less than HL available after the forwarding decrement (else emit no route). Unit tests: encapsulated inner HL == orig-1-num_addrs; drop/reject when SL >= remaining HL. Verify add_rpl_source_route root-originated branch does NOT need the tunnel decrement (no inner/outer tunnel there) - pin with a comment or test. Files: rust/lichen-core/src/ipv6.rs, rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs. Lands first (decap child uses the const).
